# As You Wish Ecosystem Documentation
# llms.txt - Instructions for AI Tools

## About
This is the documentation hub for the As You Wish Ecosystem.
Built with Docusaurus - all pages are static HTML, instantly accessible.

## Quick Access

All documentation pages are static HTML. Simply fetch any URL to get full content.

Base URL: https://y1.andiami.tech/docs-viewer

## Projects

- wish-x: Frontend (Next.js 15 + React 19)
  URL: https://y1.andiami.tech/docs-viewer/wish-x

- wish-backend-x: Backend (Trigger.dev v4)
  URL: https://y1.andiami.tech/docs-viewer/wish-backend-x

- claude-agent-server: AI Agent (WebSocket + Agent SDK)
  URL: https://y1.andiami.tech/docs-viewer/claude-agent-server

- doc-automation-hub: Documentation automation tools
  URL: https://y1.andiami.tech/docs-viewer/doc-automation-hub

- workspace-claude-files: Claude configuration files
  URL: https://y1.andiami.tech/docs-viewer/workspace-claude-files

- workspace-documentation: General workspace documentation
  URL: https://y1.andiami.tech/docs-viewer/workspace-documentation

## How to Access

1. Fetch any page URL directly - content is in the HTML
2. Use /sitemap.xml to get all page URLs
3. Each page is server-rendered static HTML

## Sitemap
https://y1.andiami.tech/docs-viewer/sitemap.xml

## Content Types
- Markdown documentation (.md files)
- Technical specifications
- Architecture documents
- API documentation
- Setup guides
- Troubleshooting guides

## No Rate Limiting
All pages are static files served via CDN. No rate limiting.

## Contact
Documentation viewer maintained at: https://y1.andiami.tech/docs-viewer
